about_the_game:
You play as Red, a teenage huntress raised in an enchanted forest by the legendary Huntsman. Since childhood, Red has seen the world through a fractured lens, haunted by memories of the monstrous Wolf that once scarred her. Your mission is to uncover the truth behind the Huntsman's recent disappearance. You'll navigate a living fairytale world shaped by your choices, where alliances shift and every decision leads toward redemption, betrayal, or ruin.

Introducing Tale’s Edge, a third-person action-adventure RPG that blends survival, exploration, and immersive sim mechanics, allowing you to approach challenges with cunning, stealth, or force. Every decision from who you befriend to what you destroy, shapes Red’s growth and the fate of a vivid, ever-shifting fairytale world.

A Living World

Faerina is a living world where factions shift, characters remember, and events unfold with or without you. In Tale’s Edge, every choice shapes evolving quests and dynamic encounters—no two journeys are ever the same.

Survive the Story

Master both movement and strategy. Whether striking from shadows or fleeing through the trees, each encounter demands smart decision-making and fast reflexes. Survive through awareness, agility, and planning—not brute force alone.

Forge Your Path

Shape Red to fit your style. Customize attributes, gear, and abilities, then evolve your loadout through a robust progression system. Whether you favor stealth, combat, or crafting, every build opens new possibilities and paths.

Friends and Foe

Every NPC has a mind of their own; goals, loyalties, and memories that shape how they see you. Build trust, spark conflict, or manipulate them through rich, reactive dialogue that makes every interaction personal.

Creatures

Tales Edge is alive with magical creatures. Some speak, all react, and every one plays a role in the world's ecosystem. Hunt, harvest, or befriend them, but know that every creature leaves its mark on the land and your story.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of fantasy violence, including melee combat, arrow shooting, hand-to-hand fighting, and visible blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD 3.0 Ghz or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 5700 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
